name: omnifi
description: Non-custodial multi-chain DEX with independently engineered EVM and Solana implementations

scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:evm && pnpm test:solana
scripts.security:slither: cd chains/evm && (slither . --config-file slither.config.json --json slither-report.json || test -s slither-report.json)
scripts.security:solana: cd chains/solana && cargo test && cargo audit && cargo deny check
scripts.security:regression: cd chains/evm && forge test --match-path test/security/SecurityRegression.t.sol --evm-version cancun
scripts.security:all: pnpm security:secrets && pnpm security:deps && pnpm security:evm && pnpm security:slither && pnpm security:solana && pnpm security:infra && pnpm security:invariants && pnpm security:regression
